title: Episode 1: The Hidden Nexus
blurb: After the last bell, a symbol on the wall begins to glow...

panels.text: After the last bell, Hahn Intermediate School grew quiet. But Ana and her squad, Isabella, Anayah, Luna and Kacee, were not ready to go home just yet.
Near the front entrance, Ana stopped. On the wall, an old H.A.H.N. symbol was glowing a soft violet. It hummed, like it was trying to say something.
Someone had to reach out first. Who touched the symbol?

options.label: Ana
options.after: Ana reached out first, bravely. Her friends rushed to join her, and soon all five hands were on the symbol. (+5 points)

options.label: Isabella
options.after: Isabella read the symbol carefully, then touched it first. Her friends rushed to join her, and soon all five hands were on it. (+5 XP)

options.label: All together
options.after: The squad counted down, three, two, one, and touched the symbol at the very same moment. (+1 skill point)

panels.text: Light flooded the hallway. The lockers turned to crystal. The ceiling melted into a violet sky full of stars. The school had become something new: the Nexus.

panels.name: The Sensei
panels.text: "Welcome, heroes," said a calm voice. A tall figure in glowing robes stepped out of the light, his face hidden deep inside his hood. "I am the Sensei. I made the Nexus, and I have been waiting for you."

panels.tip: Isabella whispers: "Let's check our supplies. Stay calm and count."
panels.q: The Sensei gives each of the 5 heroes 12 glowing crystals. How many crystals is that in all?

panels.name: The Sensei
panels.text: "The Nexus needs a Keeper," the Sensei said. "Someone wise, who cares about every student." He reached up into the swirling light and gently pulled down someone very surprising: the principal.

panels.name: The First Keeper
panels.text: In a flash of purple, the principal changed. Curly blonde hair, white and gold robes, a purple cape lined with crystals, a glowing crystal staff, a spellbook, and two gray wolves at her side. "I am... the First Keeper?"

panels.tip: Luna grins: "That's a word we can figure out from the story!"
panels.q: The Sensei calls her the First Keeper. What does a keeper do?
choices: Looks after something and keeps it safe

panels.name: The First Keeper
panels.text: The First Keeper smiled. "Learning, kindness and hard work will make this world stronger. Heroes, are you ready to protect the Nexus together?"
Ana looked at her squad. One by one, they nodded. "We're ready," said Ana. Outside the crystal windows, new doors began to glow.

panels.tip: Kacee points at the crystal wall: "Look how the light bounces. Science!"
panels.q: Light bounces off the shiny crystal walls. What is it called when light bounces off a surface?

panels.text: To be continued... The Sensei says new adventures are waiting in the Nexus. Episode 2 is coming soon!
